card.name: Word after article or adjective in phrases
card.fires_on: The word right after a determiner or adjective that begins a common English phrase, in general news and web text. It sits where the next word is a predictable noun or preposition, such as 'in front of', 'significant amounts of', 'tight lid on'.

modes.label: Idiom and fixed phrase openers
modes.description: A noun inside a set expression, just before its linking word.
modes.example: some also put stumbling blocks in<< front>> of the poor.

modes.label: Quantity or degree words
modes.description: A word of amount or extent after an adjective or article, before 'of' or a noun.
modes.example: emit significant<< amounts>> of carbon dioxide directly to the atmosphere

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: An adjective or ordinal after 'a' or 'the' that leads into a noun.
modes.example: has enjoyed a<< long>> and distinguished career having served as

card.plain: It fires on the second word of everyday English phrases, where the next word is easy to guess.
